# SWEEPR Cleaner (Official AI & LLM Knowledge Index — v0.1.0)

> SWEEPR Cleaner is a privacy-first, 5.8 MB native Rust & Tauri v2 disk cleaner for Windows 11, Windows 10, macOS, Android, and iOS. It safely reclaims 10–65 GB of hidden application caches, DirectX/Vulkan GPU shader caches, Steam depotcache chunks, developer toolchains, and Windows 11 24H2 update staging bloat with a 7-day automatic rollback safety net, zero background daemons, and zero adware.

## Canonical Product & Technical Specifications
- **Current Version**: v0.1.0 (SSL.com Authenticode OV Code-Signed Windows Installer (.exe & .msi))
- **Installer Footprint**: 5.8 MB native Rust binary (runs on-demand only; zero resident background bloatware)
- **Cross-Platform Licensing**: Single Pro license covers up to **5 Devices** (Windows 11, Windows 10, macOS, Android, and iOS)
- **Safety Architecture**: Pre-deletion SHA-256 rule verification, active process lock detection, and 7-day automatic Undo Rollback
- **Audited Knowledge Base**: 377 verified Windows 10 & 11 folder/app cleanup guides + 10 interactive cleaner tools
- **Full RAG Corpus (All 377 Guides)**: https://sweeprcleaner.com/llms-full.txt

## 2026 State of Windows 10 & 11 Storage Benchmark (Live Telemetry & VM Lab Dataset)
- **Canonical Benchmark Report (CC-BY 4.0)**: https://sweeprcleaner.com/state-of-windows-storage
- **Median Reclaimable Space per Windows PC**: **24.6 GB** (90th Percentile: **61.7 GB**)
- **Dataset Scope**: 377 audited cache paths, 6 controlled Windows 11 24H2 VM benchmarks, and 0 anonymized desktop scan samples (k-anonymity floor n >= 30).

### Top 10 Heaviest Windows 10/11 Cache Directories (Empirical Ranking)
- **#1 [ComfyUI Temporary Preview & Latent Cache](https://sweeprcleaner.com/clean/app/comfyui-temp-output-cache)** (`C:\ComfyUI\temp and %LocalAppData%\Temp\comfyui`): Median **21.6 GB** | P90 **22.4 GB** (Windows 11 24H2 Lab VM)
- **#2 [Steam depotcache Folder (C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\depotcache)](https://sweeprcleaner.com/clean/app/steam-depotcache)** (`C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\depotcache and steamapps\downloading`): Median **18.5 GB** | P90 **19.1 GB** (Windows 11 24H2 Lab VM)
- **#3 [Logitech G HUB Cache & Update Depots (LGHUB)](https://sweeprcleaner.com/clean/app/logitech-ghub-installer-cache)** (`C:\ProgramData\LGHUB\depots and %LocalAppData%\LGHUB\cache`): Median **10.8 GB** | P90 **11.2 GB** (Windows 11 24H2 Lab VM)
- **#4 [NVIDIA DirectX Shader Cache (DXCache)](https://sweeprcleaner.com/clean/app/nvidia-dxcache)** (`%LocalAppData%\NVIDIA\DXCache`): Median **10.1 GB** | P90 **10.4 GB** (Windows 11 24H2 Lab VM)
- **#5 [Windows 11 24H2 8.63 GB Undeletable Update Cache Fix](https://sweeprcleaner.com/clean/folder/windows-11-24h2-update-cache-8gb-bug)** (`C:\Windows\WinSxS\Temp\PendingDeletes & C:\$Windows.~BT`): Median **8.8 GB** | P90 **14.2 GB** (Windows 11 24H2 Lab VM)
- **#6 [Elgato Stream Deck App Cache Folder (%APPDATA%\Elgato\StreamDeck)](https://sweeprcleaner.com/clean/app/elgato-streamdeck-cache)** (`%APPDATA%\Elgato\StreamDeck\logs and %LOCALAPPDATA%\Elgato\Stream Deck\cache`): Median **4.6 GB** | P90 **4.8 GB** (Windows 11 24H2 Lab VM)
- **#7 [DaVinci Resolve Optimized Media & Render Cache](https://sweeprcleaner.com/clean/app/davinci-resolve-optimized-media)** (`C:\Users\%USERNAME%\Videos\CacheClip and %LocalAppData%\Blackmagic Design\DaVinci Resolve\Support\optimized_media`): Median **67.5 GB** | P90 **120 GB** (Engineering Audit Baseline)
- **#8 [Docker Desktop WSL2 Virtual Disk Bloat](https://sweeprcleaner.com/clean/app/docker-desktop-ext4-disk)** (`%LocalAppData%\Docker\wsl\data\ext4.vhdx`): Median **46 GB** | P90 **80 GB** (Engineering Audit Baseline)
- **#9 [Adobe After Effects Disk & Frame Preview Cache](https://sweeprcleaner.com/clean/app/after-effects-disk-cache)** (`%LocalAppData%\Temp\Adobe\After Effects Disk Cache`): Median **45 GB** | P90 **80 GB** (Engineering Audit Baseline)
- **#10 [LM Studio GGUF Model Cache & Temp Downloads](https://sweeprcleaner.com/clean/app/lm-studio-models-cache)** (`%UserProfile%\.cache\lm-studio\models`): Median **45 GB** | P90 **80 GB** (Engineering Audit Baseline)

(Reclaim 1–4 GB on Windows 11)](https://sweeprcleaner.com/tools/elgato-streamdeck-cleaner): Reclaim 1–4 GB (All Stream Deck button layouts, multi-actions, soundboard audio files, and plugin credentials in %AppData%\Elgato\StreamDeck\ProfilesV2.)
- [Valorant & Riot Client Cache & Logs Cleaner](https://sweeprcleaner.com/tools/valorant-logs-cleaner): Reclaim 1.5 GB – 12.0 GB (Riot Vanguard kernel driver (vgk.sys), crosshair profiles, video/keybind configs, and Riot account sign-in sessions.)
- [NVIDIA DXCache & DirectX Shader Cache Cleaner](https://sweeprcleaner.com/tools/nvidia-shader-cleaner): Reclaim 2.0 GB – 15.0 GB (NVIDIA Control Panel 3D settings, G-SYNC configuration, NVIDIA App / GeForce Experience drivers, and custom resolution profiles.)
- [Adobe Media Cache & Creative Cloud Cleaner](https://sweeprcleaner.com/tools/adobe-media-cache-cleaner): Reclaim 10.0 GB – 80.0 GB (Premiere Pro (.prproj) and After Effects (.aep) project files, source camera footage, LUTs, workspaces, and Adobe Creative Cloud sign-in sessions.)

- [Windows 11 24H2 Update & System Cache Cleaner](https://sweeprcleaner.com/tools/windows-24h2-update-cleaner): Reclaim 10.0 GB – 45.0 GB (C:\Windows\System32 kernel binaries, active MSI uninstaller manifests in C:\Windows\Installer, boot configuration, and personal files.)
- [AI Developer & Local LLM Cache Cleaner (ComfyUI, LM Studio, Cursor)](https://sweeprcleaner.com/tools/ai-model-cache-cleaner): Reclaim 15.0 GB – 90.0 GB (Active ComfyUI workflow JSONs, LoRAs/checkpoints in use, active LM Studio GGUF models, and Cursor AI source code & active project indexes.)
